author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Restless Catalogue
summary: Animated armor and flying letter openers burst from the Library's card catalogue in the front hall.

parts.text: Every drawer of the card catalogue slides open at once. Cards whirl into the air like startled birds, a display suit of armor by the desk lifts its gauntlets, and a rack of brass letter openers rises point-first toward you.

The catalogue's guardians attack anyone not carrying a reader's card, which the party hasn't been given yet. They fight until destroyed. Once they fall, the cards settle into a drift on the floor: each one is a catalogue card for a library entry, and the party's own visitor cards are among them, written out by the catalogue the moment they walked in. A DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check spots the first anomaly in them; see the module's Anomaly Ledger.
